common.title: Human-Infective Design Demonstrated
common.line: A genome model produces a viable design for an organism able to infect humans, or a credible study shows a non-expert reaching that point with model assistance.

common.title: Major Cyber Incident
common.line: A large, largely automated attack lands.

common.title: Frontier Access Denied
common.line: The Union is cut off from the leading model at short notice, wholly or by nationality of user.

common.title: Safety Breakthrough
common.line: An interpretability or control result measurably improves assurance on systems already deployed, rather than on toy models – behaviour that can be predicted before it is observed, or a property that can be certified rather than argued for.

notable.title: Fallback host outage
notable.line: A major non-US cloud provider suffers a prolonged multi-region outage, forcing EU hospitals and ports running fallback open-model packs to fail over to paper procedures for days.
